answer: Because each quill escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the echo ledger records every share and the quartz audit reveals the split. Assembling that for 55 aliases means 55 times 4 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. A bond must be split across 4 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. That is 19 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
